name: calendar

frames.best_why: A complete month grid with weekday headings and all date rows, and no cursor over the navigation controls.

tagline: Month grid with arrows that step through dates to pick one.
summary: A single-month date picker: the month and year sit between two chevrons above a grid of weekday headings and date numbers. Arrows move between months and a click chooses a day.
appearance: A borderless dark grid about 300 pixels wide. A centred month and year in white sits between two grey chevrons, followed by a row of two-letter weekday headings and five or six rows of light grey date numbers, with days from adjacent months dimmed.
behaviour: Clicking a chevron moves the grid one month back or forward and a faint round highlight appears under the pointer. Clicking a day selects it with a filled circle, and today keeps a small dot beneath its number.
demo_content: November 2026, paged forward to December 2026 with the next arrow.
search_phrases: pick a date from a grid
use_when: A form needs one date chosen from a familiar month grid with quick month-by-month browsing.
avoid_when: Only one month is on screen, so reaching a distant date takes repeated clicks.
customise: Any date-picker prop can set the selection mode, chosen date, month limits and disabled days; per-part styling is overridable through the classNames map.
weight_why: One month of plain buttons rendered by the date library; no timers or loops.

a11y.note: Grid arrow-key movement and labelled weekdays come from the date library, but selected and today rely on colour and a tiny dot alone.

issues: No frame selects a day, so the selected styling cannot be judged
The grid has no border or card behind it and floats on a large empty dark stage
polish_why: Clean, legible grid with familiar behaviour; no selected state shown and no frame around it.
